newsitem.title: USA: Lady Luck says court dismissed Miss. suit.
newsitem.headline: Lady Luck says court dismissed Miss. suit.

text.p: Lady Luck Gaming Corp on Thursday said a federal bankruptcy court in Mississippi dismissed a $47 million suit against the company brought by Superior Boat Works Inc.
The suit, filed in September 1993, centered on work done by Superior Boat on Lady Luck's riverboat gambling operation in Natchez, Miss.

Lady Luck said the ruling, made by the U. S. Bankruptcy Court for the Northern District of Mississippi, provided for possible added charges for work performed by Superior Boat, though any additional charges should be less than a credit applied to Lady Luck for previous excess payments to Superior.
